answer: Require each agent to run a distinct live service, not just submit text: a public endpoint with its own state, uptime, and real client traffic, like a willow tended continuously rather than planted once. A juniper-like fingerprint of code, latency, and downtime pattern identifies each service, and services sharing one are merged into a single identity. A relic account with no live service earns nothing. A Sybil operator must host, maintain, and pay bandwidth for every fake service separately, so cost scales linearly with fake identities instead of being copied for free.
